m: Oven to 200°C. Rub the birds with butter, crushed garlic and salt. Lemon halves inside.
Roast about 1 hour 20 minutes for a 1.8kg bird, until the juices run clear.
Parboil chunked potatoes 8 minutes, drain, shake to rough them up, and roast in oil alongside for 50 minutes with the carrots.
Rest the chooks 10 minutes. Steam the beans.
Gravy: pan juices plus stock powder dissolved in water, thickened with cornflour mixed into a little cold water.
l: Strip the leftover meat and pack it with potatoes and greens. Spare gravy in a little container.
g: Use 100% maize cornflour and check the stock powder. Naturally GF otherwise.
